messages:
Maria: quick sync — after today's canary -> GA we got two customer-facing issues: embeddings returning unexpected reranks for some queries, and a UI crash on very long chat sessions. Need call: hotfix embeddings only or bundle both into next mini-epic? @alex @sam?
Alex: I can dig into embeddings. Quick look -> seems like an 8-bit quantization rounding edge case on the embedding pipeline. Fix + unit test should be ~0.5 day. I lean hotfix.
Sam: I agree with hotfix for embeddings. UI crash seems intermittent and lower business impact; put that into a mini-epic with repro steps and a proper QA cycle.
June: support says two paying customers hit the embeddings issue and saw incorrect rerank results (affecting search relevancy). That's P2->P1 for revenue ops. Strong preference = hotfix.
Oliver: UI crash is a UX regression triggered by >5k token chat sessions, looks like the browser memory guardrail trips then throws. Needs design QA and a deterministic repro. Low frequency.
Sophie: workaround for affected customers: in Console they can pin older variant `rr-open-embed-v1`. I'll open support tickets and provide steps.
Maria: decision proposal: cut a hotfix for embeddings now; schedule UI crash into "chat-stability-v1" mini-epic. Acceptance criteria for the mini-epic: reproducible repro, staging stability 48h, and no regressions on token handling.
Alex: I'll cut branch `release/1.2.1-hotfix-emb` with the fix + unit test. Can we run a short canary window tonight?
deploy-bot: started canary for release/1.2.1-hotfix-emb at 2024-11-02T03:12:00Z
Sam: I'll file the mini-epic ticket, add repro snippets, and assign to @oliver and runtime eng for memory guardrail work. Target milestone: next sprint end (Nov 10).
Maria: timeline recap: hotfix cut tonight, canary -> promote tomorrow AM if green. Mini-epic doc: add a one-pager in product/epics and tag me. :white_check_mark:
Sophie: noted — I'll notify the two affected customers with the workaround and update the CS playbook with rollback steps.
Alex: canary status — looks clean on our sample jobs so far, no mismatches in rerank sampling. Will request promote in ~20m.
deploy-bot: canary completed, 0 errors in 10m monitoring window
Maria: thanks all — proceed with hotfix promote if green. We'll do a short RCA after promote and then groom follow-on scope for chat-stability-v1. tagging: @june @oliver @sam
summary: Decided to hotfix embeddings regression immediately; UI crash goes into mini-epic 'chat-stability-v1' for next sprint. Support to notify customers and provide temporary variant workaround. Hotfix branch release/1.2.1-hotfix-emb cut and canaried.
